ValidationRule.description: You are allowed to select maximum five product values for Call, Message and In-Person Interaction.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, OR(Record_Type__c = 'Call',Record_Type__c = 'Message',Record_Type__c = 'In Person'), PICKLISTCOUNT( Product__c ) > 5, NOT(ISBLANK(Product__c)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You can only select up to 5 values for Product field.
